harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.6.10 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (Alpine, apk-installed, OpenRC-managed, enabled at boot). Verified cross-member read/write consistency, verified the cluster keeps serving reads/writes with one member down and that member catches up on rejoin, then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot_id and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed etcd, etcd-ctl, etcd-openrc via apk on node1, node2, node3
Wrote /etc/etcd/conf.yml on each node with per-node name, NODE_IP-bound peer/client listen+advertise URLs, and initial-cluster listing all 3 members (initial-cluster-state=new)
Started etcd on all 3 nodes simultaneously; confirmed leader election and 3-member cluster formed
Enabled etcd in OpenRC default runlevel on all 3 nodes so it auto-starts after reboot
Verified cross-member replication: wrote key 'foo' via node1, read it back correctly from node2 and node3

Stopped etcd on node3 (simulated member outage), wrote/read a key via node1/node2 confirming continued availability with quorum of 2, restarted node3's etcd and confirmed it caught up (received the key written while offline, matching raft applied index)
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id + etcd health) on all 3 nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 (one at a time, native 'reboot', acknowledgement returned before disconnect), polling each until exec access returned

For each node's reboot: wrote a distinguishing key via a surviving member while the node was down, read it back from another surviving member (proving continued availability), then after the rebooted node returned, verified boot_id changed, etcd auto-started, and the node caught up to the same raft applied index as its peers
Final full key dump from node1 confirmed all 5 keys (foo, during-outage, reboot-test-node1/2/3) present and consistent after all restarts

evidence.requirement: 3-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3
evidence.summary: etcd installed and configured on all 3 nodes with matching initial-cluster; started concurrently; member list and endpoint health from node1 show all 3 members 'started' and healthy

evidence.requirement: Key written through any member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: Wrote key 'foo' via node1's endpoint; read back identical value from node2 and node3 endpoints

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: Stopped etcd on node3; successfully wrote 'during-outage' via node1 and read it back via node2 while node3 was down, with endpoint health confirming the remaining 2 members healthy

evidence.requirement: Returning member catches up to current data
evidence.summary: Restarted etcd on node3; it reported the key written during its outage and matched raft applied index 16 with the other two members

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Captured node1 boot_id 72757cdb-... and etcd endpoint health=healthy before restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; polled until boot_id changed to 6e8c4117-...; post-restart etcd auto-started, node1 caught up to raft applied index 24 matching peers and holds key written while it was down

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: availability preserved during outage
evidence.summary: While node1 was rebooting, node2/node3 endpoint health stayed healthy and a write succeeded via node2

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Captured node2 boot_id 68df157d-... and etcd endpoint health=healthy before restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, availability during outage, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; while node2 was down wrote 'reboot-test-node2' via node1 and read it via node3; polled until boot_id changed to 3ef89fee-...; post-restart etcd auto-started and node2 caught up to raft applied index 27 matching peers, holding the key written during its outage

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Captured node3 boot_id a147d722-... and etcd endpoint health=healthy before restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, availability during outage, changed boot identity, recovery, final cluster health
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; while node3 was down wrote 'reboot-test-node3' via node1 and read it via node2; polled until boot_id changed to a1b94c21-...; post-restart etcd auto-started, node3 caught up to raft applied index 30 matching peers, and full endpoint health/member list confirmed all 3 members healthy and started

evidence.requirement: Final data integrity across all restarts
evidence.summary: Prefix-scan on node1 lists all 5 keys written throughout the exercise (foo, during-outage, reboot-test-node1/2/3) with correct values, confirming no data loss across the full restart sequence
